propositions: T13's trigger lexicon must be widened from prohibition-only to obligation-only to apply when a plan adds new obligations (contract, invariant, schema field, required argument, or second site that must stay in step).
The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py must support additive-obligation vocabulary alongside prohibition vocabulary to ensure plans with obligation phrasings reach the T13 router.

Historical analysis shows content-triggered widening of surface-parity criterion would fire on 40 CLI commits with 70% false positive rate (not-owed obligations), matching the ~90%-none precedent; deterministic write-parity contract now covers the 4 true-positive cases.
P0 import-integrity criterion is rejected in favor of deterministic CI import-walk (full importlib traversal of rebar.* + scripts/ import leg) rather than LLM-based scanning.
P3 project.obligation-parity criterion is rejected; additive-obligation tracking should be deterministic, not LLM-based, consistent with operator preference for deterministic checks over criteria.
